rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates traditional I Ching divination with AI responses using the bibliomantic approach from Philip K. Dick's "The Man in the High Castle", where characters consult the ancient Chinese oracle for guidance on important decisions. The server implements the complete 64-hexagram system with authentic three-coin method simulation using cryptographically secure randomness, providing tools for divination, bibliomantic consultation, and hexagram lookup alongside resources for loading hexagram data directly into AI context. Built with educational and philosophical reflection purposes in mind, it demonstrates how ancient wisdom traditions can be thoughtfully integrated with modern AI through clear ethical boundaries, making it valuable for creative writing, philosophical contemplation, and exploring the intersection of traditional divination systems with contemporary technology.
